faqs.question: What does Essential Decor actually handle on a project?
faqs.answer: Everything under one contract: design development, material and FF&E procurement, authority approvals, construction, MEP, joinery and installation — through to final handover. One team is accountable end to end, so you're not coordinating separate contractors yourself.

faqs.question: How long does a typical commercial fit-out take?
faqs.answer: It depends on scope and approvals, but most commercial fit-outs run 6–14 weeks from signed design to handover. We give you a realistic programme up front and an average quote turnaround of 48 hours so you're not waiting to get started.

faqs.question: Which authorities and areas do you work across?
faqs.answer: We're registered and approved to work across Dubai and the UAE, including DMCC, TECOM, DEWA, Dubai Municipality, Trakhees, Dubai Healthcare City Authority and other relevant free zones and municipalities.

faqs.question: Do you work on occupied or live premises?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly deliver phased fit-outs and renovations in occupied buildings — sequencing works, noise and access to minimise disruption to your business or tenants.

faqs.question: What sectors do you have experience in?
faqs.answer: Commercial offices, hospitality and F&B, wellness and healthcare, and institutional spaces — each with its own compliance, materials and functional requirements, which our in-house team designs and builds around.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Tell us what the space needs to do, who'll use it, and your budget range via the contact page. We come back within 48 hours to arrange an initial conversation and site visit.
